🚀 WE'RE HIRING: HUMAN CAPITAL INTERN!
Interested in starting your career in Human Capital and gaining hands-on experience in the world of HR? This is your chance!
Hypernet Technologies (an XL Smart Company) is looking for a Human Capital Intern to join our team! 🌟
If you're eager to learn, detail-oriented, and passionate about people, we'd love to meet you!
📩 Interested? Send your CV to recruitment@hypernet.co.id
Feel free to share this opportunity with someone who might be a great fit!
